en.headline: Unvaccinated 12-year-old girl becomes second child flu death this season
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the girl died on Tuesday after developing influenza A complications, and urged the public to get vaccinated promptly.
body: A 12-year-old girl who had not received this season’s influenza vaccine has died, becoming the second paediatric flu-related death in Hong Kong since the current season began in late June, the Centre for Health Protection said on Wednesday.

The centre said the girl, who had underlying health conditions, developed fever, cough and diarrhoea on 17 October. Her condition worsened and she was taken to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital on the evening of 19 October, where she suffered a cardiac arrest. After resuscitation she was admitted to the paediatric intensive care unit.

A respiratory specimen tested positive for influenza A (H1). She was diagnosed with influenza A infection complicated by septic shock, disseminated intravascular coagulation and multi-organ failure, and died on 20 October. She had no travel history during the incubation period.

Centre controller Edwin Tsui said local influenza activity remains high and urged eligible people, especially children and other vulnerable groups, to receive the seasonal vaccine as soon as possible. The centre has recorded 25 severe paediatric cases this season.

zh.headline: 12歲未接種疫苗女童染甲流不治 成今季第二宗兒童死亡個案
zh.dek: 衛生防護中心指女童周二不治，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發敗血性休克等，呼籲市民盡快接種疫苗。
body: 衛生署衛生防護中心周三表示，一名12歲女童染上流感後不治，是今個流感季節以來第二宗兒童死亡個案。
中心指，女童有自身健康狀況，自10月17日起出現發燒、咳嗽及腹瀉，19日晚情況惡化，被送到東區尤德夫人那打素醫院急症室，一度心臟驟停，經搶救後入住兒童深切治療部。
她的呼吸道樣本對甲型（H1）流感病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發敗血性休克、血管內彌漫性凝血及多重器官衰竭，延至20日不治。她於潛伏期內沒有外遊，亦未接種本年度季節性流感疫苗。
中心總監徐樂堅指，目前本地流感活躍程度仍高，呼籲市民特別是兒童及高危人士盡快接種疫苗，以減低重症及死亡風險。今季至今已錄得25宗兒童嚴重個案。
